Not much else is known about its full figure, however.
Fragmented Devil Form (American percentage-20%): When 20% of its body is summoned by the President of the United States, the Gun Devil resembles an enormous floating humanoid figure with multiple building-sized rifles for arms, a roughly skeletal body crammed full of disembodied screaming heads, and an oversized barrel and slide emerging from its skeletal face. The Gun Devil is also missing the lower half of its body and is instead replaced by 6 long giant 7.62×51mm NATO ammo belts attached to the bottom of its torso.
The main parts of both its arms appear to be M4 Carbines, with other well-known assault rifles in its arms well. These include: the AK-47 , the M16A1, and the Mk18 assault rifle. Both arms appear to wield the same rifles. The Gun Devil's head appears to be the slide and barrel of a large M1911 missing the hammer. Some of the firearms on its back appear to be unknown Infantry Rifles, all others are completely unidentifiable.
Fiend Form (Aki Hayakawa): After the Gun Devil took over Aki Hayakawa's body and becomes the Gun Fiend, its hair is let down with its eyes and forehead covered in dark veins. The barrel and slide of an M1911 is seen protruding out of its face in between its eyes with the gun's hammer sticking out the back of its head, its left forearm is replaced with an M4.

entries.name: Grape Devil
entries.content: The Grape Devil is a devil who might be the embodiment of the fear of grapes. The Grape Devil's appearance is like a cluster of eyeballs connected with each other by veins, little arms and intestine-like appendages.

entries.name: Ghost Devil
entries.content: The Ghost Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of ghosts. The Ghost Devil is a large devil with a somewhat cylindrical body; its torso is covered in white flowers with either yellow or pink centers and has several arms instead of legs. In the colored manga it seems to have skin (arms and legs) of a grey hue but change in tint depending on the scene. It's head appears old and desiccated, with long dark wavy or curly hair and sunken cheeks. The Ghost Devil's eyes and mouth are sewn shut. In the anime, the flowers are pink on the outside and blue on the inside.

entries.name: Galgali, Violence Fiend
entries.content:
Galgali was the Violence Fiend and a Public Safety Devil Hunter from Tokyo Special Division 4. Galgali possesses the corpse of a fairly thin man and is dressed in a suit with a hood, and wears a plague doctor gas mask which covers his features. In the colored manga, Galgali's mask is colored in a very bright green, red and orange that looks like the colors of a parrot. In the anime, the mask has more muted colors, such as grey and beige, and some yellow.
When he doesn't have his plague doctor mask on, he becomes much taller, very muscular, has spiky black hair, and has 4 empty eyes.
Despite his moniker as the Violence Fiend, he is extremely polite and straightforward. He apologized to Beam after hitting him in self-defense and told the Spider Devil to evacuate the area when he mistook her for a human lady.

entries.name: House Devil
entries.content: The House Devil is a Devil that embodies the fear of houses. The House Devil is a large inn in the shape of a cross. It can be compared to the body of a human.

entries.name: Hirokazu Arai
entries.content: Hirokazu Arai was a Public Safety Devil Hunter. He was a new recruit working under Makima's special squad paired up with Kobeni Higashiyama. Hirokazu is a young man with short spiky hair, a scar on his left cheek and black round eyes. He is usually seen wearing a black suit. Hirokazu is shown to have high moral standards as he became flustered when Himeno promised a kiss to whoever killed the devil on their mission and he stated a young woman should not be giving herself away before marriage.

entries.name: Hirofumi Yoshida
entries.content:
Hirofumi Yoshida is a Public Safety Devil Hunter. Formerly a Private Devil Hunter, he was considered by Makima as a high-class bodyguard specialist along with Kusakabe and Tamaoki. After joining Public Safety, he has kept tabs on Denji by attending Fourth East High School and has intervened on multiple occasions to prevent Denji from revealing his identity as Chainsaw Man.
Yoshida has mid-length smooth black hair, dark eyes, and a slim face. There is a beauty mark under his lips. He has eight piercings on his left ear, though usually, only six are visible below his hair. His piercings are likely a reference to his contract with the Octopus Devil.
Yoshida is quite playful and mischievous and loves to have small talk with his opponents during battle. Although Yoshida always has a smile on his face, he is also ruthless. This side of him is demonstrated when he mercilessly kills the Joey of the three Immortal Brothers in a back alley after showing up behind the surviving brother. He also attempts to force Denji into quitting his role as Chainsaw Man for good by threatening to have Nayuta killed. From his interactions with Kishibe, he is revealed to be still attending high school.
Yoshida is someone who doesn't like to beat around the bush and prefers to get straight to the point, as seen when he meets Fami and immediately asks her about her next moves, even threatening her if she doesn't cooperate with him and Public Safety. His nearly perpetual smile can vanish and devolve into a grimace on rare occasions, like when he becomes too frustrated by Denji's lack of cooperation and seeming stupidity

entries.name: Himeno
entries.content:
Himeno was a Public Safety Devil Hunter working under Makima's Tokyo Special Division 4 Squad and she was partnered with Aki Hayakawa.
Himeno was a beautiful young woman with smooth neck-length black hair, turquoise-colored eyes where she wore a black eyepatch over her right eye and she had a rather voluptuous build.
Himeno was shown to be a mature and experienced superior to the new recruits working under her. She generally carries herself with upbeat body language and was capable of staying calm under extremely stressful situations, such as the initial phase of her group's battle against the Eternity Devil. Himeno motivated Denji by offering him a french kiss, implying that she's at least somewhat perceptive of the people around her and was willing to take unorthodox approaches in order to ensure the best possible results from him.
However, despite this cheerful presentation, Himeno also held an extremely pessimistic worldview as a result of having witnessed multiple partners die suddenly in her line of work. This knowledge that Devil Hunters typically die as a result of their career combined with the teachings of her master eventually lead to her developing a nicotine addiction as a coping mechanism.

entries.name: Hell Devil
entries.content: The Hell Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of Hell. The Hell Devil takes the form of a centaur with a featureless head except for its giant mouth which is open in a grimace. It is covered with taut flesh which is constantly burning.

entries.name: Haruka Iseumi, Devil Hunter Club President
entries.content:
Haruka Iseumi is a student at Fourth East High School, where he is the president of the Devil Hunter Club and student council. He claimed to be Chainsaw Man but in actuality, he is an obsessed fan of Chainsaw Man.
Haruka is a slim young man who wears a bandana, an all-black uniform, and a military cap with a symbol. He has black hair combed to the side of his face. He has a pull cord in his chest identical to that of Pochita's in Denji's chest, later revealed to be a surgical implant.
Haruka seems to be benevolent and prideful on a surface level; he has a habit of constantly introducing himself in an extravagant manner and he holds his position as president of both the student council and the Devil Hunter Club in high regard. As of such, he tends to lead those around him, instructing others on how to handle a situation, utilizing their skillset to their advantage.
However, he can also be very demeaning to those he views as having no worth to the club, such as when he berates Asa for accidentally destroying her phone when she tried to help out. It's also shown that he can be fairly manipulative, lying to others that he is indeed the real Chainsaw Man, likely in order to boost his own popularity. He is now a part of the Chainsaw Man Church.

entries.name: Justice Devil
entries.content:
The Justice Devil is a Devil that embodies the fear of justice.
The Justice Devil appears as a large, caterpillar-like monster with no eyes nor nose and stone-looking pads on its shoulders.
As a Devil, the Justice Devil possesses all of the standard Devil abilities. During the battle against the Falling Devil, the Justice Devil has proven itself to be exceptionally powerful, forcing even Chainsaw Man to flee from it.
Immense Speed: The Justice Devil was easily able to keep up with Denji and Asa, even whilst they were escaping on the Super Chainsaw Man Motorcycle.
Immense Strength: The Justice Devil was able to effortlessly rip through entire buildings and crush cars using it's tentacles. It also managed to knock Chainsaw Man unconscious twice.
Regeneration: The Justice Devil was able to endlessly regenerate it's lost tentacles.
Shapeshifting: The Justice Devil was able to transform it's limbs into giant hammers, as well as create a new, enormous jaw on its belly.
It's unclear when the name of the Justice Devil began to be used to convince people to enter into contracts with the Fire Devil. The class president, later killed by Asa Mitaka when the War Devil took over her body, and then Yuko claimed to have made a contract with what they thought was the "Justice Devil", and that was still at Fourth East High School, possibly having made contracts with other students.
The true Justice Devil is later summoned from Hell by the Falling Devil, to be fed a series of dishes she would prepare, including Asa Mitaka. After nearly devouring both her and Denji, the Justice Devil is brutally killed by an enraged Falling Devil for vomiting, under the influence of Nayuta which made their taste similar to a fecal matter-like, both Asa that Denji.
Meanwhile, the Justice Devil's name would be used by Barem and the Chainsaw Man Church to convince people to enter into contracts with the Fire Devil, convincing them that the "Justice Devil" "would grant them the power to transform into any form they desired", with a person claiming to be Chainsaw Man who in a press conference claimed to have entered into a contract with the "Justice Devil".
The true Justice Devil's corpse is later inspected by the Department of Public Safety's Devil Name Consultant, who then reveals that the true Justice Devil had been killed during the Falling Devil's attack, and that the contracts in circulation could not link with it; later, Barem revealing that the culprit behind the previous contracts was the Fire Devil.

entries.name: Joey
entries.content:
Joey was a private devil hunter from the United States and part of the American Thugs. Joey is a tall man of average build, with long disheveled hair, and sinister eyes. He wears a suit similar to the Public Safety Devil Hunter uniform. Joey is the middle sibling but appears to be the least mature out of his siblings to the point that he is described as a dumbass by his older brother. He is also a womanizer, being after women no matter what country he is in. He enjoys smoking.
Despite his crude personality, he is still very close to his family, he reacted in shock and was angered by his brother dying, and tried to calm himself and Aldo before his death.

entries.name: Kusakabe
entries.content:
Kusakabe was a Public Safety Devil Hunter in Miyagi Division 2.
Kusakabe has dirty blonde or light brown hair which extends to his upper neck. He wears black glasses, has either hazel or yellow eyes with a slightly muted hue, and a black suit like most of the Public Safety Devil Hunters.
Kusakabe is precautious and rigorous. He is the one who become furious when Denji tried to eat his food even after it fell to ground. As claimed by Makima, he is one of the best bodyguards. He cares about his mission and prepared.

entries.name: Kobeni's car
entries.content: Kobeni's car is a car bought by Kobeni Higashiyama. It is a 1965 Fiat 500. Kobeni's car is small, with a roundish roof, small wheels, a boxy front, a rectangular window shield, two doors and an older fashioned steering wheel. Kobeni's car is seen painted a bright yellow, leaning more towards pastel than vibrant.

entries.name: Kobeni Higashiyama
entries.content:
Kobeni Higashiyama is a former Public Safety Devil Hunter who started as a new recruit working under Makima's Special Squad. She later resigned from being a Devil Hunter after the battle against the Darkness Devil in Hell. Kobeni is a petite young woman with short brown hair, in both the anime and colored manga, tied in a ponytail. She has brown eyes with white pupils.
On her face are four moles, two under her left eye, one on the lower right side of her mouth, and one on her left cheek. She normally wears a professional suit and she has two hair clips.
Kobeni is exceptionally cowardly with few moments of courage. Her first confrontation with the Eternity Devil leads to her being paralyzed with fright and babbling. She is shown to easily crack under pressure and breaks down in tears when the group becomes trapped in the hotel and she is confronted with the possibility of them all starving to death without any rescue.
However, when Kobeni gets into action she had proven to be cool-headed and efficient, ruthlessly dealing with both the Katana Man and Akane Sawatari and forcing them to retreat; only breaking down in a panic once the fighting is over.

entries.name: Knife Devil
entries.content: The Knife Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of knives.

entries.name: Kishibe
entries.content:
Kishibe is a Public Safety Devil Hunter from Tokyo Special Division 1, but after the assault on the Special Divisions, he became captain of the Tokyo Special Division 4.
Kishibe is a grizzled man with scraggly facial hair and a stitched scar running across his left cheek from his mouth. At 194 cm (6'4"), he is quite tall. His hair is blonde with an underlying dark brown buzzcut with two piercings on his left ear and one on his right ear.
He is often seen with a silver hip flask which he frequently drinks from.
Kishibe is a stoic, straightforward individual. Due to his immense strength and skill, he often undertakes his work with a calm formality, displaying little emotion as he does so. Though he tends to speak in a relaxed, polite manner, his actions often showcase an immense brutality garnered through many years of Devil Hunting. Though he sometimes expresses emotions such as surprise and sadness at certain events, his face and voice remain entirely neutral.
Despite this stoicism, Kishibe has proven on numerous occasions to be something of a sentimental and emotional individual. During his training of Denji and Power, despite his stated hatred of Fiends and Devils, he grows affectionate towards the pair, telling Makima of his concerns for their safety. He later takes care of Meowy for them as a favor when they go on a trip. Similarly, he refuses to look at the corpse of Quanxi upon her death due to their implied past-friendship, despite the two's attempts to kill one another earlier in the day.
Kishibe told Denji and Power that he prefers to be called 'Master' while training them. He admits that he enjoys booze, women and killing devils.

entries.name: Kenzo
entries.content: Kenzo is a Private Sector Devil Hunter who has been working as one for the past seven years. Kenzo is an average man with short brown hair parted in the middle. Kenzo is especially confident in his skills to take out devils, but he makes sure not to get too cocky. He takes the opportunity to work with other devil hunters should the chance arise, but has little problems working alone.

entries.name: Kato
entries.content: Kato was a Public Safety Devil Hunter. Kato is an average man who normally dresses in the standard Public Safety uniform. He appears to be a bit older and missing an eye.

entries.name: Katana Man, Samurai Sword, Katana Hybrid
entries.content:
Katana Man, known officially as Samurai Sword, is a Devil-human Hybrid who merged with the Katana Devil. His grandfather was the Debt Collector killed by Denji and because of that, he teamed up with Akane to get revenge on Denji and steal his heart.
Katana Man is a tall man with short black hair and notable sideburns.
Katana Man is a selfish and cruel-hearted man who only cares about killing Denji and forcing him to apologize for killing his grandfather. He will sacrifice innocent people and even his own comrades to do so, being willing to cut through them just to get to Denji. He has shown a complete disbelief in Denji's excuse that he killed his grandfather because he was a zombie and accused Denji of being a liar.
After being free from Makima's control her now works in Tokyo Special Division 7. He still retains his hatred of Denji, and resents him even more than before. Those negative feelings have become worse, to the point of attacking and slicing a devil only because he talked about "Chainsaw Man" and his justice, claiming that he has no sense of justice.

entries.name: Long
entries.content:
Long was one of Quanxi's fiends, and one of her harem members.
Long possesses a corpse with shaggy, dark purple-red hair that is around shoulder length. She also has a pair of red horns. Her eyes have red irises and yellow pupils. Her sweater is white with red shorts. She has muted red sneakers as well as cuffs on her hands.
Not much is known about her personality as she only shows expressions and not much else. She seems to be submissive and always seen with her wrists chained.

entries.name: Loneliness Fiend
entries.content: The Loneliness Fiend was a Devil that embodies the fear of loneliness. The Loneliness Fiend's seems to be an average man with numerous fangs.

entries.name: Leech Devil
entries.content:
The Leech Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of leeches.
The Leech Devil has a large wrinkled body with four legs and two tentacle-like arms. Her limbs are tipped with circular orifices like a leech and her face consists entirely of a single large mouth with blocky teeth. She has long black hair, and three pairs of udder-like glands.
The Leech Devil, like most devils, has a great hatred for humans. She cared deeply for the Bat Devil, referring to him affectionately and trying to avenge him after his death. She and the Bat Devil shared a dream of devouring all humans together. Despite her relationship with him however, she seemed willing to spare Denji purely because he has a cute face.

entries.name: Masaki Ando
entries.content: Masaki Ando was a Public Safety Devil Hunter. Masaki is a plain man with short dark hair. Masaki is mindful of the law even in intense situations as he requested permission to use his gun before defending himself.

entries.name: Meowy, Nyāko
entries.content: Meowy is a cat previously owned by Power, now being owned by Denji after Power's demise. Meowy is a cat with brown ears and a brown spot on the top of its head.

entries.name: Minami Nakano
entries.content: Minami Nakano was a Devil Hunter that was included between Kishibe and Quanxi's love-triangle. But after, she would resign from the Public Safety Devil Hunter. Minami is described as a young woman with a baby face and dark pixie haircut, as well as having big, round eyes that give the impression of a puppy. Minami is very outgoing and full of energy, as can be seen when she's being trained by Quanxi. Despite being told to rest multiple times, she keeps trying to push herself to become stronger.

entries.name: Miri Sugo, Sword Man, Longsword Hybrid
entries.content:
Miri Sugo is a Devil-human Hybrid that merged with the Longsword Devil.
Miri is a young man of average height with unkempt black hair and visible dark circles under his brown eyes. He wears a dark blue drawstring hoodie underneath his Fourth East High School uniform. During his time as one of Makima's brainwashed servants, he wore the Public Safety Devil Hunter suit. His human appearance is noted as looking halfway between Denji and Haruka by his fellow students. He is a member of the Chainsaw Man Church.
Initially, Miri's real personality was unknown due to being brainwashed and mind-controlled by Makima, although it seemed like he enjoyed attention and wanted to impress Makima.
Post-mind control, Miri does seem to be fairly regretful for his actions during the fight, as he was able to seek out Denji to talk to him in private and empathize with his current situation. His regret stems from how he allowed himself to be manipulated by Makima, similar to Denji, and as of such not only does he highly value his newfound free will, but he also wants to befriend Denji due to their similar circumstances. Despite his best intentions, however, others such as Fumiko have noted how he still seems to be prone to being manipulated by others, despite his insistence that the opposite is true.
He is shown to easily fall for the Church's conspiracy theories. When Denji, the real Chainsaw Man, tells him that those are lies, Miri admits that the Church may not be fully honest but that it saved many people regardless and that the ends justify the means, therefore proving Fumiko's point. Denji's words do seem to have influenced him somewhat, as he's later seen questioning their decision-making.
Out of the four known members of "The Weapons", he alone seems to have the strongest moral compass, as he's shown to be heavily hesitant towards their plan to carry out mass murder in hopes of drawing Chainsaw Man out from hiding. He refuses the Whip Hybrid's idea that they were merely weapons, insisting that he is a human and he should think for himself.

entries.name: Mold Devil
entries.content: The Mold Devil is the devil who embodies the fear of mold.

entries.name: Mr. Kanbayashi
entries.content: Mr. Kanbayashi is the owner of a large villa on a hill. It is later revealed that said villa is the House Devil in disguise.

entries.name: Muscle Devil
entries.content:
The Muscle Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of muscles. The Muscle Devil's initial form appears as a small cycloptic snake with a weak and innocent appearance to be deceptively vulnerable.
By manipulating his muscles he reveals his true form as a large snake-like mass of skinless muscles with multiple eyes and a mouth full of crooked teeth.
The Muscle Devil is sadistic and cunning, using trickery to make Denji let his guard down and controlling a little girl's body as a pawn to do so.
He has a great hatred towards humans; taking a little girl prisoner to torture her and breaking Denji's arm just as a demonstration of his abilities.

entries.name: Michiko Tendo
entries.content:
Michiko Tendo was a Public Safety Devil Hunter from Kyoto.
Tendo was a tall woman with black hair that was tied back in a messy ponytail with long side bangs reaching past her shoulders.
She tended to wear the standard Public Safety Devil Extermination uniform, and had a horizontal scar across her face—a feature she shared with Yutaro Kurose.
Like Yutaro, Michiko is nervous around Makima and insists that she doesn't want to join the special division. Michiko appears to have some sensitivity as she suggested stepping out to give Aki some space when she and Yutaro found him crying.

entries.name: Marshmallow Devil
entries.content:
The Marshmallow Devil is a devil who embodies the fear of marshmallows.
The Marshmallow Devil has the appearance of a harmless-looking blob of flesh with four eyes, two in the back and two at the bottom. It has many small tentacles at the base of its body, most probably used for movement.

entries.name: Madoka
entries.content:
Madoka is a former Public Safety Devil Hunter. After the assault on the Devil Hunters by the Gun Devil's associates, he was one of the few survivors and decided to leave his job as a Devil Hunter.
Madoka is a man of average height with short black hair. He has two horizontal scars crossing his face and wears glasses.
Madoka is cautious and rational, resigning when things get too dangerous for Public Safety's Special Division despite being one of the few survivors.

entries.name: Makima, Control Devil
entries.content:
Makima was a high-ranking Public Safety Devil Hunter who took Denji in as her human pet.
She is later revealed to be the Control Devil who embodies the fear of control or conquest. Following her death, she is reincarnated as Nayuta.
Makima is a Devil resembling a human woman in her twenties of average build, and marginally above average height (168 cm/5'6" to 173 cm/5'8"). She has long light red/pale auburn hair, normally kept in a loose braid with bangs reaching just past her eyebrows and two longer side bangs that frame her face. Her eyes are yellow with multiple red rings within them, making them the only visible sign of her inhuman nature.
Her usual Public Safety uniform consists of a white long-sleeved shirt, a black tie, black pants and brown shoes.
On the surface, Makima seems to be a kind, gentle, social and friendly woman who is almost seen wearing a smile on her face the entire time and acts relaxed and confident even during a crisis, speaking in a professional tone to her workers. As her natural appearance is nearly identical to that of a human, she avoids disclosing her Devil nature to most of her underlings and spends much of the series posing as a human contracted to a Devil rather than a Devil herself. However, this is only a façade that she uses to fulfill her ultimate goal: After the death of Aki Hayakawa, Makima begins to reveal her true colors to Denji. Makima's true face is of someone that is Machiavellian and calculating, who sees people around her as nothing more than "dogs" she can use as much as she likes and must obey her without any hesitation.

entries.name: Mantis Devil
entries.content: The Mantis Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of mantises. The Mantis Devil has only been partially seen, possessing massive, sickle-like limbs.

entries.name: Nuclear Weapons Devil
entries.content: The Nuclear Weapons Devil was a Devil that embodies the fear of nuclear weapons. At some point, prior to the event of Chainsaw Man, the Nuclear Weapons Devil was eaten by Pochita, thus ridding its existence along with the existence of nuclear weapons from the world. This causes one of the Horsemen, Yoru, to pursue the Chainsaw Man in order to make him vomit the nuclear weapons back up.

entries.name: Nomo
entries.content: Nomo was a Public Safety Devil Hunter and a member of Tokyo Division 2.

entries.name: Nobana Higashiyama, Kobeni's Brother
entries.content:
Nobana Higashiyama is a highschooler attending Fourth East High School and a member of the Devil Hunter Club as well as a tour guide for the Chainsaw Man Church. He is a brother of Kobeni Higashiyama.
Nobana bears a notable resemblance to Kobeni, especially his face and eyes. Similarly to Kobeni he also has moles on his face, precisely two just under his right eye. He has short, brown hair that is kept in line by six hair clips on his right side and falls to his face on the left. Similarly to his sister, he is also quite short. Nobana wears the standard boys' uniform of Fourth East High School and has the typical cap from the Devil Hunter Club, though he doesn't wear it. He is always seen with sweat on his face, often also blushing.
Much like his older sister, Nobana is perpetually anxious but, unlike her, even more so and he hasn't had any moments of competency or bravery so far. He gets easily embarrassed and stutters uncontrollably when merely trying to say the word "sex". Similarly to Kobeni, his parents put a lot of pressure on him and force him to do activities he doesn't enjoy, like joining the Devil Hunter Club. Nobana's mind is fragile, as he goes insane after a few days of being trapped in the aquarium, licking the glass senselessly.
Later, Nobana joins the Chainsaw Man Church and becomes fully devoted to their cause, easily believing the lies which the Church tells its followers showing he's very susceptible to manipulation and conspiracy theories. For example, he believes that the concept of marrying as an adult is a system from the USA designed to control the Japanese like slaves and encourages students to have children and marry each other.

entries.name: Needle Devil
entries.content: The Needle Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of needles.

entries.name: Nayuta, Reborn Control Devil
entries.content:
Nayuta is the reincarnation of the Control Devil following Makima's death. To prevent her from becoming similar to her previous incarnation, she was taken by Kishibe to be raised by Denji as Denji's younger sister.
Nayuta takes the appearance of a young girl with long dark brown hair woven into a braid and flung over her shoulder with one long bang that covers her left eye. Similar to Makima and Yoru, her eyes are yellow with multiple red-colored rings within them.
Denji describes her as a "huge-problem child with an extreme personality". As a humanoid Devil, she has a natural inclination towards humans. Just like her previous incarnation, Nayuta seems to like dogs, as seen by her getting along with Makima's dogs. However, unlike Makima, Nayuta does not seem to be controlling the dogs using her ability.
Nayuta is protective of Denji, wanting him to break off his relationship with Asa Mitaka as every woman he met tried to kill him. She seems to be very demanding, holds peace signs, and wants ice cream every day. Denji describes her as very smart.
Nayuta has a rather amoral personality, where much of her morality is based on her own personal preferences. When Fami revealed a Prophecy which would spell the end of humanity and the rise of Devils, Nayuta found it to be very fun. But when Fami noted this would mean the end of modern conveniences like pizza and Chinese food, she immediately changed her mind. Nayuta also refused to help Fami since she was busy with school, demonstrating how seriously she takes her education and how she's unwilling to help others if it gets in the way of her life.

entries.name: Nakamura
entries.content: Nakamura was a Public Safety Devil Hunter and a part of Tokyo Division 2. He is an average looking man with a bit of a square or rectangular face.

entries.name: Octopus Devil
entries.content: The Octopus Devil is a Devil that embodies the fear of octopuses. The Octopus Devil has only been partially seen as a mass of giant, oversized tentacles with suckers.

entries.name: Punishment Devil
entries.content:
The Punishment Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of punishment.
Because of the circumstances in which the Punishment Devil made its only appearance in one gigantic amalgamation of several Devils, it is rather difficult to pinpoint exactly how it looks. They are a being of what may be several conjoined humanoid bodies with distorted faces, each carrying a different weapon. Outside of the bodies they have several conjoined arms on a opened mouth that looks very similar to the mouth of Snake Devil. The inner body is a very light brown or brownish-yellow and the outer body with the conjoined arms on a mouth have a bolder yellow.

entries.name: Princi, Spider Devil
entries.content:
Princi was the Spider Devil, a devil who embodies the fear of spiders, and is a Public Safety Devil Hunter from Tokyo Special Division 4.
Princi resembles a young woman with waist-length black hair. She has eight legs ending in scythe-like, curved points which are sharp enough to stab through flesh. She appears to have a zipper in the center of her face with the pull under her chin to unzip upwards.
She normally wears a shirt and elaborate bow-tie with a knee-length skirt.
Princi usually takes a human shape so she tends to be friendly to humans and works as a devil hunter herself. She is shown to have a polite, docile and proper personality however she will still kill people for just looking at her the wrong way.
She showed no reaction at being mistaken for a human by the Violence Fiend and impassively killed zombies without any change in expression. She was bold enough to attack the Darkness Devil directly and showed no expression after being mutilated. She's also extremely devoted to Makima and will follow her orders directly, even if she has personal qualms with them.

entries.name: Pochita, Chainsaw Devil
entries.content:
Pochita is the Chainsaw Devil who embodies the fear of chainsaws. He was the original Chainsaw Man prior to becoming Denji's heart.
Near-death State Appearance: After disappearing from his battle with the Four Horsemen and Weapon Devils, Pochita is reduced to a “near-death state”. In this state, he appears to be a small orange canine-like Devil with a chainsaw-like appendage protruding from the center of his head. Handles emerge from his body allowing him to be wielded like a chainsaw, and his short tail is in the shape of a chainsaw's pull cord.
Normal Appearance: His true Devil form is of a large, humanoid Devil with four arms and a chainsaw protruding from each, with another chainsaw coming from the front of his head, similar to Denji's hybrid form. An intestine still connected to his stomach is wrapped around his neck, resembling a scarf or a collar.
Unlike most Devils Pochita communicated solely through barks and whines like an actual dog. However, after fusing with Denji, he is able to communicate telepathically with him. He continuously communicates with Denji through dreams, warning him to not 'open the door'.
Pochita deeply cared for Denji after his life was saved by the human, despite the Devil's general hatred toward humankind. He willingly gave up his heart to Denji so that he could fulfill his dreams which Pochita loved hearing about. He also showed that he knows Denji very well and is able to mimic Denji's personality and behavior to fool Makima.
Pochita exhibits a more erratic personality when in his true Devil form, as shown when he quickly murders anyone who expressed even the slightest bit of hostility towards him in the burger joint. However, even in this state he remembers his friend Denji's wish of trying a hamburger that isn't rotten and going on a date with a girl, which leads him to kidnap Kobeni. Later, he tells Denji that he always dreamed of being hugged, but his strength made that impossible, implying that his murder spree at the burger joint was accidental due to him being unable to properly control his strength around others.

entries.name: Pingtsi
entries.content:
Pingtsi was one of Quanxi's fiends, and one of her harem members.
Pingtsi possesses a corpse with dark hair with a blue hue and has an futakuchi-onna-like ponytail along with eye-length bangs and slightly longer side bangs. Given the same coloration of the ponytail and the rest of the hair it is unknown if the ponytail was originally a part of the corpse or a part of the devil that took the form of one. All of the hair bands she wears have been shown as red. She wears a long sleeved, knee-length black dress with white cuffs and a dress collar. She wears plain black shoes and black leggings. Her eyes on her ponytail seem to be purple while the eyes on her face may either be red or also purple. She is considerably shorter than the rest of Quanxi’s fiends.
Pingtsi is a very cheerful, talkative girl who likes to share useless facts in order to impress or entertain Quanxi.

entries.name: Pig Devil
entries.content: The Pig Devi is a devil that embodies the fear of pigs. The Pig Devil's appearance is that of an extremely large pig with four eyes. Two of which are very small and just above its snout.

entries.name: Reze, Bomb Hybrid, Bomb Girl
entries.content:
Reze, also known as Lady Reze or Bomb Girl, is a Bomb Devil Hybrid from the Soviet Union, who was sent to Japan with the mission of stealing the Chainsaw Man's heart.
Reze appears to be a young woman or girl, and is of slender build. She has shoulder-length purple hair and emerald-green eyes. She is shown to be prone to blushing heavily. While posing as a civilian, she is seen wearing a choker in order to conceal the grenade pin in her neck, which she uses to transform.
Reze initially appears to be a kind and gentle girl who has a crush on Denji soon after meeting him, taking interest in him at first sight and was portrayed to be as somewhat enthusiastic, as shown when both Denji and her have a drink of coffee at the Café she had worked at. She is shown to be laughing at his jokes and isn't afraid to get close and intimate with him.
Reze is also shown to be a bit of a tantalizer, teasing Denji on some occasions, such as when she had seen how he forced himself to drink the coffee and teased him for being "such a kid," While also displaying a rather sympathetic side to her, showing her concern about Denji never attending school as a child or in his current position. She shows little respect towards the owner of the café she works at, calling him a cheapskate for docking her pay.
This was later revealed to be just a façade in order to get her closer to Denji; even her seemingly true reactions like blushing in his presence were results of a harsh military training that Reze was subjected to from a young age. However, Reze had shown mercy towards Denji despite her mission, and at the end of the Bomb Girl arc, Reze missed her train to meet Denji again at the café, to take his offer on running away with him.
Despite her fake crush on Denji, Reze somewhat reciprocated his feelings towards her, and felt similar to him since they had both never been to school. Although using more manipulative type of fighting, she seems to not enjoy killing or harming others and prefers to avoid it, unless it's necessary for her mission.

entries.name: Quanxi, First Devil Hunter, Crossbow Hybrid
entries.content:
Quanxi, also known as The First Devil Hunter, is a Crossbow Devil Hybrid and renowned Devil Hunter from China.
Quanxi is a tall woman with cream colored hair tied back in to a ponytail. She wears an eye patch over her right eye, has a brown left eye, and possesses an atheletic build. She is also seen wearing a black tank top tucked into waist-high pants with a large belt during her mission to retrieve Denji's heart. When in combat, Quanxi dons a set of sheathes on her back, holding up to three swords which resemble Dao.
After being freed from Makima's control she joined Tokyo Special Division 7. Quanxi currently wears the standard Public Safety Devil Hunter suit and tie. She also wore that outfit in the past and during her time as one of Makima's brainwashed servants. Her eyepatch has a different design, now appearing to be made of frilled lace instead of leather. She also wears a matching, black lace choker.
Quanxi is calm and stoic, having no shame in discussing business while she's in bed with her harem of fiends, showing little emotion even as her girlfriends fawn over her. However, she does deeply care for her fiends, making her one request for a reward be that they are given human rights and a basic education, and not attacking them even after they have been turned into dolls at the cost of her own safety.

entries.name: Santa Claus
entries.content:
Santa Claus is a global hive mind of perfect doll assassins, indistinguishable from regular humans, controlled by one individual with the help of the Doll Devil. Due to the form Santa Claus took when Cosmo sent her mind into her own mind, the aforementioned individual and the main body of Santa Claus is presumed to be a mysterious woman who has a contract with the Doll Devil allowing her to control several different bodies, one of which poses as a Devil Hunter from Germany.
Santa Claus’s main body is presumed to be a dark blue-haired, green eyed woman with a mole under her eye. She wears a dark skirt and a orange sweater.
After she ate a piece of Darkness Devil's flesh, she gained several doll arms and appendages and her legs were made of doll heads from the pile of dolls she was in. During night, she transformed and became larger and more devilish. She also grew horns just like the Darkness Devil has and sharp teeth. In the colored manga the darker skin of the body at night is a dark purplish-gray while the lighter doll head torso and legs are the same color as Santa’s human skin as the doll heads mimic her original face when she was human. She has 40 eyes on her monstrous form in total, with 10 arms at day and even more arms at night.
Santa Claus is a tactical and strategic being. She hid herself in a remote region, while using a perfect doll to bargain and negotiate. When introduced, Santa Claus appear to be a lecherous being who asked for several children of either gender as their reward for bringing in the Chainsaw Devil from Japan, apparently for use in contracts and for pleasure (although this is likely done to instill strong emotions into them and groomed them to be the next perfect doll). It is later revealed that three of the children are meant to be used for contract with Hell Devil along with the old man perfect doll.
She has no issues with forcibly recruiting large numbers of civilians to work for her by transforming them into puppets. She has shown no regard for those who seem to care for her. For example, when her ally Tolka had subdued Denji, Santa Claus turned him into a puppet to communicate with the Darkness Devil and complete the contract.

entries.name: Sato
entries.content: Sato was a Public Safety Devil Hunter. Sato is a man with short light hair who tends to wear the standard Public Safety Devil Extermination uniform.

entries.name: Sea Cucumber Devil
entries.content:
The Sea Cucumber Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of sea cucumbers.
The Sea Cucumber Devil has a cylindrical fleshy body with countless human fingers emerging from all sides. At the top of its body is a large orifice and a human skull which emerges from just underneath it. Its body is magenta and blue, with blue fingers.

entries.name: Seigi Akoku
entries.content:
Seigi Akoku is a highschooler attending Fourth East High School and a member of the Devil Hunter Club.
Seigi is a heavyset teenager and is taller than average. He wears the typical male uniform of a high school student and a black military cap. When fighting Yuko, he wore spiked brass knuckles. After his battle, he lost an eye, which is bandaged and later replaced with a black eyepatch.
He seems to be steadfast and disciplinary, going right into the action when Yuko attacked the school to buy time for more Devil Hunters to show up.

entries.name: Seraphim
entries.content:
Seraphim is either a Devil or a Fiend who was under Makima's control. They were shown alongside Dominion, Virtue, and Princi, as well as the corpses of Power, Galgali, Angel, and Beam.
Seraphim is some sort of humanoid being that resembles a bug. They have antenna and bug eyes, as well as green skin and fly wings.

entries.name: Shiina
entries.content: Shiina is a police officer of the Kanagawa Prefecture. Shiina is tall gaunt man. During the mission to take down Akane Sawatari and the Katana Man he was equipped in full riot gear obscuring most of his features.

entries.name: Skin Devil
entries.content: The Skin Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of skin.

entries.name: Snake Devil
entries.content: The Snake Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of snakes. The Snake Devil has the appearance of an enormous snake with a large mouth made out of interlocking arms and hands instead of teeth. It has green scales/skin and a red eye with black sclera.

entries.name: Spear Hybrid
entries.content:
Spear Hybrid (real name unknown) is a Devil-human Hybrid that merged with the Spear Devil.
The Spear Hybrid is a tall man with short blonde hair who wears glasses. He also has a bit of stubble on his chin.
During his time as one of Makima's brainwashed servants, the Spear Hybrid wore the standard Public Safety Devil Hunter suit and tie. After her defeat, he wears a sweater underneath a light-colored coat.
After being freed from Makima's control, the Spear Hybrid's true personality reveals him as a sadistic, cold-hearted individual with little qualms about harming innocent lives. He also appears to be devoted to Barem's cause of luring out Chainsaw Man with a massacre, even smugly grinning at the thought of making women and children scream in agony when planning to slaughter them.

entries.name: Stone Devil
entries.content: The Stone Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of stones. The Stone Devil appears to be a gargoyle-like being with stone skin, small bat wings, clawed legs and a draconic head with multiple pairs of eyes.

entries.name: Subaru
entries.content:
Subaru is a Public Safety Devil Hunter and a member of Kyoto Division 1. He had trained Miyagi's 2nd Division.
Subaru is a tall man with messy black hair and a short beard.
When Subaru, Kurose, and Tendo are driving to Tokyo, the trio of brothers (The American Thugs) set down a spike strip and make them crash. The brothers then shoot them all dead.

entries.name: Taiyo Hayakawa
entries.content: Taiyo Hayakawa was the younger brother of Aki Hayakawa who was killed by the Gun Devil. Taiyo was a young boy who heavily resembled his older brother. Taiyo was innocent and fun-loving, caring a lot for his older brother and parents.

entries.name: Takashi Inoue
entries.content: Takashi Inoue was a civilian working for Katana Man and Akane Sawatari. He was killed by Makima through the use of her Force Manipulation power.

entries.name: Tamaoki
entries.content: Tamaoki was a Public Safety Devil Hunter and a member of Miyagi Division 2. He has short hair, faint eyebrows, several eyebags and a mole on his forehead.

entries.name: Tanabe
entries.content: Tanabe was a Public Safety Devil Hunter and a member of Tokyo Division 2.

entries.name: Mr. Tanaka
entries.content:
Mr. Tanaka was a teacher of Asa Mitaka's class. He was later killed by Yoru, the War Devil, who turned him into a human weapon during her battle with the class president. Mr. Tanaka was a tall man with black hair and parted bangs. He mostly wore white shirt with black tie, and a coat.
Mr. Tanaka was a kind man who values life and the well being of his students. He took special care to make sure Asa Mitaka felt included in the class, including asking the class president to befriend her and apologizing to the class on her behalf for the death of Bucky.
However, he may have been more unscrupulous then he seemed, as it was later revealed that he was sleeping with the class president despite their age difference and student-teacher relationship.

entries.name: Tolka
entries.content:
Tolka is a private devil hunter from the Soviet Union.
Tolka is a tall, plain-looking man with light hair and pale eyes. When he goes hunting he dons a hoodie and a quiver on his back.
Tolka has been conditioned to believe that taking a life is not a serious matter thanks to his hunting trips with his master. After being questioned on whether or not he can kill a sixteen-year old boy like an animal, Tolka affirms that he can do so.
Tolka is devoted to his master; being willing to kill another person so that she could retire peacefully, as well as wiping her mouth when she eats.

entries.name: Tomato Devil
entries.content:
The Tomato Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of tomatoes.
The Tomato Devil has a large round red body resembling a tomato, with multiple bulging eyes sprouting its surface in all directions. It stands upon eight human-like arms which emerge from its base and has a large vertical mouth at the center of its body.

entries.name: Tomono
entries.content: Tomono is a friend of Yutaro Kurose and Michiko Tendo. Tomono is a young man with short dark hair and wears glasses.

entries.name: Tsugihagi
entries.content: Tsugihagi is an unnamed fiend, and was one of Quanxi's harem members. Tsugihagi possesses a corpse with short green hair and has grey sclera and yellow eyes. She has normal pale skin albeit with a grey hue in shading with stitches covering her face, thighs and upper arm. She wears long black skirt, loose yellow cardigan with 4 buttons and black clogs. Nothing is currently known about Tsuguhagi's personality as she didn't speak a word in all her appearances; however, she is extremely loyal to Quanxi and her women.

entries.name: Typhoon Devil
entries.content:
The Typhoon Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of typhoons.
The Typhoon Devil's true form resembles a gigantic humanoid surrounded by a swirling storm of brain matter with the top part of its head exposed revealing more brain matter which is connected to the storm around it. In Asa Mitaka's flashback, his face is that of an old man with a thick mustache.
The second incarnation of the Typhoon Devil has the face of a baby instead of an old man with a thick mustache.

entries.name: Virtue
entries.content:
Virtue is either a Devil or a Fiend who was under Makima's control. They were shown alongside Dominion, Seraphim, and Princi, as well as the corpses of Power, Galgali, Angel, and Beam.
Virtue is a headless humanoid with brownish skin. Their hands and feet all have 2 fingers, resembling tentacles or claws.

entries.name: Zombie Devil
entries.content:
The Zombie Devil is a devil who embodies the fear of zombies. He turned various Yakuza into zombies and attempted to kill Denji.
The Zombie Devil takes the form of a giant floating limbless torso with multiple exposed organs including a brain from which tentacles emerge to connect him to zombies within his horde. A large human-like face emerges from the right side of the devil's torso unconnected to where its head should be. During the fight with Denji, he loses his right Eye and is later cut into two halves.
The Zombie Devil has a greater hatred towards humans, particularly towards devil hunters. Since devil hunters kill his own kind, the Zombie Devil seeks to kill devil hunters in return. He appears to be somewhat cunning, since he managed to trick the Yakuza and turn them into zombies.

entries.name: Yutaro Kurose
entries.content:
Yutaro Kurose was a Public Safety Devil Hunter from Kyoto Division 1.
Kurose is a man with short black hair who tends to wear the standard Public Safety Devil Extermination uniform. He has a horizontal scar across his face which is a feature he shares with Michiko Tendo.
Like Tendo, Kurose is nervous around Makima and insists that he doesn't want to join the special division.
Kurose has a noticeable accent which he tends to tone down around people from Tokyo.

entries.name: Yuko
entries.content:
Yuko is a high school student and member of the Devil Hunter Club alongside Asa Mitaka and Hirofumi Yoshida. She has a contract with the Justice Devil.
Yuko is a high school girl of average height. She is a bit shorter than Asa. She has short hair and wears dark-colored glasses.
The contract with the Justice Devil makes her capable of transforming herself into a thin and gaunt being with an uncovered brain and tentacles instead of legs.
When she's resurrected following her first death at the hands of Asa, Yuko comes back as a gigantic monster with the head of her transformed form surrounded by tentacles. In this form, she's big enough to cover several floors of the school with her body.
After being attacked by Denji, Yuko was, according to her, turned into a Devil. In this form she has the same short blonde hair and humanoid figure that she had previously. Thin tendrils run down her face, but her mouth and nose are still visible; they also cover where her eyes should be, but Yuko still seems able to see. Her arms are replaced by tendrils and tendrils run down to her calf, twisting around her legs like a dress. Yuko wore a hoodie to hide her appearance in this form.
On the surface, Yuko seems to be kind, warmhearted, and sociable. She quickly becomes friends with Asa Mitaka after partnering with her in the Devil Hunter Club, noticing her distress at being shunned by classmates due to Bucky's death. She's very altruistic and friendly, being willing to give out her shoes to Asa so that she wouldn't have to walk home shoeless soon after meeting her, and got upset when Asa gave the shoes back.
Later, it is revealed that underneath her friendly surface lies a deranged personality with a twisted sense of justice. Yuko's extremely cold-blooded and shows no remorse or concern over killing people she deems evil, all while continuing to smile and act warmly. Her warped sense of morality led her to make an illegal contract with the Justice Devil, murdering her neighbor and attempting to "take care of" Asa's bullying problem. She also knows that Yoru has taken over Asa and how they killed the Class President. She knows all this because she can read minds because of her Devil contract. The actual price for her powers is implied to be that some part of her mind, such as her sense of right and wrong or her sense of Justice, is unknowingly getting altered and radicalized by the Justice Devil.
Despite all this, she still believes herself to be best friends with Asa, and wants to fix her problems for her, even if that requires murder.

entries.name: Yoru, War Devil
entries.content:
Yoru is the War Devil who embodies the fear of war. She is a member of the Four Horsemen, who now occupies Asa Mitaka's body as a Fiend.
Following her taking over Mitaka's body, Yoru sets out to locate Chainsaw Man, whom secretly attends the Fourth East High School with them. She also coerces Asa into looking for a target to seduce and turn into a weapon. They choose Denji, however they eventually fail and lose their memories. After a meeting with Fami she becomes a secret member of the Chainsaw Man Church.
Fiend: After taking over Asa's body and occupying half of her brain, the War Devil took on her appearance, but with added facial scars across her the center of her face and left cheek, which are in the same location where Mitaka's face was slashed by the Class President. In this form, Yoru's eyes have multiple rings, similar to Makima, who was another Horseman. Her hair is also usually worn loose rather than in twin tails like Mitaka. Yoru always wears the same clothes as Asa, most commonly a school uniform.
Yoru is first shown to be very confident and prideful, treating her opponents as mere warm-ups and confidently vowing to take back nuclear weapons from Chainsaw Man. This might be a sign of her over-confidence as she lost to him previously while at full strength and is significantly weaker now. However she is aware of her limitations and will back down from a fight if she believes the odds are against her. Yoru holds little sentimental value or attachments to humans, and is mostly uncaring of Mitaka's feelings, as evidenced by her blatant disregard for Mitaka's feeling of friendship for Yuko, repeatedly asking Mitaka to kill Yuko to use as a weapon or when she goes as far as to physically hurt Asa herself to forcefully regain control albeit with the intention of saving them both. She's been shown to be very cold and logical which clashes with Asa's highly emotional personality. Since she's completely unaffected by the Falling Devil, that means she easily gets over highly traumatic events such as being almost killed by Pochita and losing her power. Due to her predisposed nature as the War Devil, she keeps getting into conflicts with everyone around her, sometimes intentionally and sometimes not. Ironically these conflicts usually serve to hurt her. Unlike her fellow Horseman Makima, who was almost always calm and composed, Yoru is more flawed, immature and naïve.

entries.name: Whip Hybrid
entries.content:
Whip Hybrid is a Devil-human Hybrid that merged with the Whip Devil. The Whip Hybrid is a woman with brown hair in the colored manga. She wears the coat of her suit like some sort of cape. She has a short stature, being the shortest among the Weapon Humans.
After Makima's defeat, she wears a baggy t-shirt with an undershirt underneath. She also wears shades.
When she was brainwashed and mind-controlled by Makima, the Whip Hybrid's real personality was unknown. According to the Second Popularity Poll, she is rather arrogant and high-handed. This is shown with her blunt response to the Spear Hybrid's proposal of competing for a date with Makima, and cackling when striking Chainsaw Man with her whips. She also thinks of herself as a superior being in comparison to mere humans, believing herself to be chosen by God.
After Makima's defeat, the Whip Hybrid has a lax attitude and is a devoted worshipper of Chainsaw Man, willing to commit mass murder with the other hybrids in order to force Chainsaw Man into appearing. When Miri Sugo has doubts about the plan, she tells him that they are mere weapons and that he should discard all other thoughts. When going through with the plan, she was the least-affected by what they were going to commit.
She also appears to be dimwitted; when asked what humans, weapons, and devils have in common, she tries to think of an answer and says they are all hard to spell. Despite this, she dislikes being mistaken for being a child by Spear, as she's instead proud of the anti-aging affects brought on by the hybrid process, even stating that she's 81 years old.

entries.name: American Thugs
entries.content: A group consisting of Aldo, Joey and their unnamed third brother. They were assassins from the USA, tasked with hunting down Denji’s heart. Due to the incident with the gun devil that killed their parents and their grandmother, they ended up becoming an assassin as their way of living. They seem to be very confident, perceiving themselves as immortals.

entries.name: Anti-Makima Squad
entries.content:
The Anti-Makima Squad was a special squad formed from military officers and devil hunters.
Led by the devil hunter Kishibe, their motive is to eliminate Makima.

entries.name: Quanxi and the Fiends, Quanxi's Harem
entries.content: Quanxi and the Fiends was a group that consisted of Quanxi and her harem of four fiends. The fiends being: Long, Pingsti, Tsugihagi and Cosmo.

entries.name: Chainsaw Man Church, Chainsaw Man Religion, Chainsaw Man Cult
entries.content:
The Chainsaw Man Church for World Peace, often referred to simply as the Chainsaw is a cult-like project developed by Fami and Haruka Iseumi alongside an unknown third member, with the stated intention of aiding Chainsaw Man to prevent the upcoming Age of Devils prophesized by Nostradamus and achieving a "world without evil." The group also has a hidden goal of weakening Chainsaw Man to allow him to live a normal life as a human.
Fami is the supposed brain of the group, whilst Haruka's role is solely to attract more people to the cause. The role and identity of the third leader is currently unknown. While Haruka is a member of the three "leaders" he isn't fully aware of the meaning behind their actions. The church also has various members of "The Weapons" among its top brass. Though despite their high positions some of them are disloyal to the church, as they're seen planning to kill other high ranking church members like Asa and plan to lure Chainsaw Man out despite the churchs' goal to stop him from fighting. Asa joined the church under the promise of separating Chainsaw Man from his Devil heart, allowing Yoru to kill the Chainsaw Devil whilst Asa can live with "her" Chainsaw Man, as a compromise between the two. Currently she's a Devil Hunter/Poster Girl for the church and is paid with its donation money.
The church uses a fake Chainsaw Man who pushes a narrative involving Adam and Eve where he wants to achieve a world without Devils, much to the chagrin of Denji. After Asa Mitaka became a member she quickly gained notoriety and many members of the public start attributing Chainsaw Man's past achievements to her instead, further frustrating Denji. Besides this the church also heavily indoctrinates its own members using conspiracy theories about America.
According to Yoshida, whilst the movement was initially founded and composed of diehard supporters and refugees from Devil attacks, its numbers exploded due to its popularity among high school students. The group also accepts donations for their campaigns, both from civilians and politicians. Its numbers were said to exceed 20,000 though the number has likely grown since.
It is revealed that the Church's main building once belonged to another cult and that the organization is run and made up almost entirely of students who are mistrustful towards adults. Every newcomer gets to sleep with a member of the opposite sex, whom they are then forced to marry in the Church's chapel and then raise their children together. The Church is also extremely anti-American, often justifying their most extreme practices by saying they’re subverting American traditions, and spread unhinged conspiracy theories about supposed acts of USA government. Denji briefly considers joining the church, but quickly changes his mind and flees once he's decided they're all insane.

entries.name: Weapon Devils
entries.content:
The Weapon Devils were a group of 7 Devils that previously served under the Four Horsemen, each member embodies the fear of a certain type of weapon. All Weapon Devils are now currently fused with a human.
There isn’t much information about the Weapon Devils before they were fused with their respective human, with very little information provided by Makima. The Weapon Devils once fought alongside the Four Horsemen against Pochita, but at the height of the battle, Pochita vanished and is reduced to a completely changed, near-death state and ended up on Earth.
The Weapon Devils also somehow ended up on Earth, whether it's because they were killed in the battle and reincarnated or not is unknown. They later become fused with different humans all throughout the world, thus creating 7 new hybrids.

entries.name: Four Horsemen
entries.content:
The Four Horsemen is a group of four powerful Devils: the Control Devil, War Devil, Famine Devil and Death Devil.
The Four Horsemen are the only individuals who still remember the names of Devils which have been devoured by the Chainsaw Man, such as the Nuclear Weapons Devil, the Nazi Devil, and others. However, it is unclear how far these memories extend: Makima, one incarnation of the Control Devil, could remember the names of devoured Devils but said that even her memories were starting to fade. The next incarnation, Nayuta, appears to bear no memories from her predecessor’s life but this is not enough evidence to determine if she automatically remembers the names of the erased or not. As revealed by Famine, none of them recognize peoples or devils faces. They all presumably use smell instead like the Control Devil was confirmed to.
Despite collaborating together, the Four Horsemen do not appear to be a cohesive unit, with each member having different goals. Makima, a former member of the Four Horsemen, intended to use Pochita's power to eradicate her fellow Horsemen despite previously battling alongside them against Pochita, whilst the War Devil wants to avoid the Famine Devil and its main goal is to make Pochita throw up the Nuclear Weapons Devil and revive him. Meanwhile, Famine is involved in the apocalypse prophesized by Nostradamus and is currently trying to prevent it from happening and enslave her sister War to aid her in this goal. Nayuta on the other hand doesn't care to involve herself with her sisters and would rather study.
It is also implied that the combined members of the Four Horsemen are almost as powerful, if not on par, with the Primal Fears due to Makima being able to slightly wound the Darkness Devil, albeit at the cost of her arm, and Fami being able to enslave the Falling Devil. However, the Horsemen do not command the same fear and respect as the Primal Fears; the reincarnated Eternity Devil openly cursed and insulted Fami when their deal didn't go according to plan.

entries.name: Four Horsemen Appearance
entries.content:
Though the members of the Four Horsemen vary in individual appearance and can look different upon reincarnation, they are all shown to be female. While the only two known incarnations of the Control Devil have been humanoids the true forms of the rest are unknown or debatable, the War Devil has an unknown true form, with the bird appearance being a near death state, but possesses the body of a teenage girl. The Death Devil has an unknown appearance, but it is implied to also be female.
Each of the Horsemen is shown to have ringed irises of their eyes. Additionally each Horsemen appears to have their own unique eye color.

entries.name: Yakuza
entries.content: The Yakuza is a recurring antagonistic faction. They are a transnational series of organized crime syndicates originating in Japan. A Mafia-like criminal organization, they are known for their strict conduct, organized fiefdom and illegitimate activity. They employ vulnerable individuals to hunt Devils for them, such as with Denji, as a major business venture.

entries.name: Fire Devil
entries.content:
The Fire Devil is a Devil that embodies the fear of fire. They are the unseen overarching antagonist of the Justice Devil arc under the guise of the Justice Devil and as a major antagonist of the entire Academy Saga.
The Fire Devil's true appearance is unknown.
Nothing is known about the Fire Devil's personality, except that their first few contracts tended to be with anyone who sees their actions as "right" and "justifiable" (such as the class president and Yuko) regardless of the actual morality behind their actions.
It is revealed that the Fire Devil is one of the devils Fami has under her control as one of her pawns, essentially all members of the Chainsaw Man Church are or become contracted with the fire devil through a large-scale mass wedding event, at the cost of their humanity.
As a Devil, the Fire Devil possesses all of the standard Devil abilities. These include the ability to make contracts with humans. The contracts with it seen so far are those with the class president, Yuko and the members of the Chainsaw Man Church (including the the Fake Chainsaw Man).
When passed off as the Justice Devil, the Fire Devil, unlike the other Devils, did not seem to ask for any price in exchange for their contract; Yuko tells Asa that the price for her contract is only to receive "a heart that shines with justice". Barem's words, however, imply that the price of the contract is one's humanity, with the contractors effectively being transformed into devils.
The Fire Devil's main power is that it can grant others the ability to transform depending on what they desire. As most people who made contracts with it were under the assumption that they were contracting the Justice Devil, many of their powers and forms reflect this. According to Barem, the forms taken by the contractors were initially more hideous and monstrous, but they later adapted to the wishes of the members of the Chainsaw Man Church.
The Fire Devil has the ability to become more powerful based on the number of people who have contracted with it. According to Barem, the number of people who have contracted with the Fire Devil through the Chainsaw Man Church is currently 350.000.

entries.name: Prophecy
entries.content:
The Prophecy of Nostradamus foresees the arrival of the Death Devil on Earth, followed by the extinction of humanity and the takeover for Devils in July 1999. It is the most important foreshadowed event to date.
According to Fami, the War Devil is the only individual possibly capable of stopping or subverting its effects. Though Nayuta considers Chainsaw Man to be equally essential.

entries.name: Guillotine Devil
entries.content:
The Guillotine Devil is a Devil that embodies the fear of guillotines. It appears as one of Fami's many pawns that she took under her control.
The Guillotine Devil is reminiscent of a large monstrous pigeon. It features a pair of ears at the base of its beak, and its head maintains a constant right-leaning tilt.
Its body is covered by wings shaped like a cape, revealing its front resembling skeletal structure consisting of a spine, pelvis, and legs. Instead of a rib cage, a large guillotine blade occupies its place. The Guillotine Devil also lacks apparent feet, as its legs bend at the knee and seem to terminate at the Tibia.
In spite of being Fami's pawn, the Guillotine Devil shows an unusual level of independence as it only cuts apart the weapons and clothes of Public Safety members instead of killing them as Fami orders it. When faced with a considerable threat, it retreats and leaves its master to fend for herself. Its intelligence seems to be on the lower spectrum as it can only repeat the phrase "Gyohnee!!" but is intelligent enough to follow its orders (to a limited extent).

entries.name: Devil Detention, Tokyo Devil Detention, Demon Detention, Tokyo Demon Detention
entries.content:
The Tokyo Devil Detention Center is a large jail facility for Devils and those who have been affected by Devils located somewhere in Tokyo, Japan. It is the facility where Denji was kept after disobeying Public Safety's orders not to transform into Chainsaw Man.
The Detention Center is an incredibly large military facility. It sports large rectangular panels going across the walls of the building. Near the entrance are sensors that allow the control room to detect intruders that infiltrate the facility. The staff inside the control room can utilize the building's weapons such as gun turrets to kill off any intruders that attempt to enter the building.
Inside the facility contains a series of long hallways and armed guards patrolling the area. Most of the rooms shown are confinement rooms holding its various prisoners captive, such as a group of Pseudo-Chainsaw People or the Devil Hunter Club trio. It is also mentioned by Fami that the room Chainsaw Man is imprisoned in is the third floor of the basement.

entries.name: Level 0: "The Lobby"
entries.content:
»⠀Safe
»⠀Unstable
»⠀Devoid of Entities
Level 0 is an expansive non-Euclidean space, resembling the back rooms of a commercial building. All rooms in Level 0 share the same superficial features, such as worn mono-yellow wallpaper, old moist carpet, scattered electrical outlets, and inconsistently-placed fluorescent lighting. Aside from these common features, no two rooms within the level are identical in layout.

The fluorescent lighting in Level 0 hums at a constant frequency. This buzzing is notably louder and more obtrusive than ordinary fluorescent lights, and examination of the fixtures to determine the source has proven inconclusive. The most prominent threat in Level 0 is the stark lack of available resources; as the fluid saturating the carpet has been deemed unsafe for human consumption, most are likely to perish before managing to find an exit due to extended dehydration, starvation, and exhaustion.

Linear space in Level 0 is altered drastically; it is possible to walk in a straight line, return to the starting point, and end up in a completely different set of rooms than the ones previously traversed. Due to this phenomenon, and the visual similarity between each room, consistent navigation of Level 0 has proven very difficult. Devices such as GPS locators and compasses fail to function within the level, and radio communications are audibly distorted and often prove unreliable.

Above the ceiling tiles in Level 0 lies a cramped, dark space, roughly one meter in height. The air in this area is stale and thick with dust, making it difficult to breathe, and electrical wires line the ceiling in all directions. Attempting to use this space as a means of navigation is impractical, as the ceiling tiles easily give way under pressure.

Entities
As reports are inconsistent and difficult to verify, it is unknown whether entities exist within Level 0. In addition, no interactions with other wanderers have ever been reported during explorations, as the individual wanderer is isolated at all times.

Entrances and Exits
Entrances
Level 0, and by extension, the Backrooms, can be accessed by accidentally noclipping out-of-bounds in normal reality. In addition, many levels can lead one to Level 0.

Exits
There are five currently known methods of exiting Level 0.

A variety of factors will eventually cause the hallways to fade into Level 1.
Breaking a wall will lead one to Level -1.
Breaking through the floor may lead to Level 27. It may also lead out into The Void.
Rarely, wandering far enough in any direction may lead one to the Manila Room.
One may occasionally find doorways constructed out of glass. These doors lead to Level 13.
Level 0.01, more commonly known as the "Ceaseless Halls," is a sublevel of Level 0 appearing as a presumably endless labyrinth of long, mundane hallways; every corridor is superficially consistent, adorned with dull yellow wallpaper, moist carpet, and spaced fluorescent lights. Though retaining a common theme, each corridor is subtly unique (i.e., a slight change in the atmosphere, sudden protuberances from the wall, minuscule changes in the floor's angle, and so forth). Navigation is strictly limited by chance, as hallways seemingly change once a wanderer breaks eye contact[1].

The lighting system of Level 0.01 is relatively poor, habitually flickering and sometimes shutting off entirely[2]. Furthermore, these panels negatively impact one's mental health; staring into the light for extended periods may cause mental disorientation[3], deterioration of rationalization, et cetera. The panels' hum has been reported to cause a nullification of one's sensory organs; this effect can be temporarily negated with Almond Water.

Throughout Level 0.01, random objects can be found, such as empty bottles, tattered shoes, broken flashlights, and so forth. However, currently, no two living beings have directly come into contact[4]. Furthermore, all lines of contact immediately cut off upon entry, inconveniencing documentation of the level's properties.

Numerous accounts have described a gradual deterioration in the level's quality as they wander farther into the ceaseless depths, depicting a consistent increase in lighting failures, broken walls, and a metallic odor. Additionally, visual and auditory hallucinations begin to increase as one's mental health falters over time. This includes the manifestation of false exits, misplaced doors, nonexistent figures, et cetera. After a certain point, exploring further into Level 0.01 may become infeasible for a variety of reasons.

Environment
Image of level 0.01

Here, a man can only die either from drowning in his own sweat, or from sheer exhaustion. Me, I'd choose exhaustion. It's much more... peaceful, you can say.
Aside from physical hazards, Level 0.01 also possesses a variety of environmental hazards. The air is extremely damp and humid, resulting in uncomfortably hot temperatures. A low fog—composed of water vapor and faint traces of Almond Water—drags across the wet carpet, obscuring a wanderer's vision as they traverse Level 0.01[5]. As one journeys further into the level, conditions will worsen as the air gets more muggy and visibility decreases.Some wanderers have reported that after passing a long distance in level 0.01, the surroundings of this level begin to show some serious damage, such as cracked floors and walls. The following table provides Level 0.01's environmental statistics.

+ Open Table
Anomalous Properties
Image of level 0.01

A million wanderers have succumbed to this wretched hell. What's one more to the pile?
Level 0.01's properties are anything but beneficial. Wanderers who enter Level 0.01 are separated from all other lifeforms[6], and they are incapable of dying from starvation and terminal dehydration. Matter brought into the level will have their colors slowly fade to match the level's dull yellows. However, if Almond Water is applied to the affected areas, it can reverse the effects.

Addendum
Image of level 0.01

Level 0.01 is perhaps one of the most peculiar levels I have encountered. Despite its barren simplicity, very few rational theories can be proposed to explain its unique properties. However, what I can hypothesize is its formation. Level 0.01 was never meant to be explored. This can be proven by the fact that its state tapers as one ventures deeper. Think of it as an endless game. You aren't supposed to finish it; you are only supposed to play it.

In fact, Level 0.01 isn't too different from the Backrooms itself. It's an infinite conglomeration of sets, stages, and environments, but whatever created it never intended someone to find the end. Instead, they created some sort of... placeholder as the end, as if they ultimately never planned an end to this madness.

But of course, I'm just blindly throwing darts at a wall. But if you throw darts at a wall forever, you'll eventually hit the target.

And that's what I intend to do.
Entrances & Exits
Entrances
A concrete door labeled with "EXIT" in green neon letters leads to Level 0.01.
Extremely long hallways in Level 0 and the lights around start to flicker
When you try a noclip at Level 0, there is a very small chance of getting into level 0.01.
Exits
Holes in the floor lead to The Void.
Some lights have crawlspaces above them. Entering this area leads to Level 28. Once a person climbs into the crawlspace, they cannot return to Level 0.01.
Due to the level's stability deteriorating as one goes further in, it is theoretically possible to noclip out after a certain distance[7].

Footnotes
 Theories suggest that the cause is non-Euclidean geometry. However, it is very unlikely.
 Blackouts are preceded by a very rapid succession of flickering.
 The effect happens regardless of the viewer's position; staring from an angle will trigger the effect much more slowly.

 It is possible that these items entered Level 0.01.
 Flashlights and other illuminary devices can easily pierce this fog.
 Entity sightings are caused by hallucinations.
 This has yet to be confirmed, as temperatures are too high to properly noclip.
